title: [Master]-Page cannot open because of FlowField 'Last Run By User'
summary: Fixes a problem where a financial reports page could not open because of the FlowField 'Last Run By User'. The change touches the Financial Report and Financial Report Audit Log tables and the Financial Reports and Acc. Schedule Overview pages.
key_points: Addresses a page failing to open because of the 'Last Run By User' FlowField
Changes in table 88 Financial Report and table 8390 Financial Report Audit Log
Pages 108 Financial Reports and 490 Acc. Schedule Overview adjusted
Regression tests added to ERM Account Schedule II in the W1, CZ and NA layers
